title: Confidential City Matters
summary:
*   Austin City Council held a special meeting solely to announce its immediate move into a closed executive session.
*   The private session was authorized to discuss sensitive matters, including legal consultations, real estate transactions, and economic development negotiations.
*   Council assured the public that any final actions, decisions, or votes resulting from these confidential discussions would be made in a future open session.
transcript:
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Special Called Council Meeting
June 03, 1981
5:30 Ρ.Μ.
First Floor Conference Room
124 West Eighth Street
The meeting was called to order with Mayor McClellan presiding. Roll Call: Present: Mayor
McClellan, Mayor Pro Tem Trevino, Councilmembers
Deuser, Duncan, Goodman, Mullen, Urdy
Absent: None
Mayor McClellan opened the meeting scheduled for 5:30p.m., stating that this was a Special
Called Meeting of the City Council for the purpose of public announcing that it will
convene in a closed or executive session authorized by Section 2, Paragraphs (e), (f) and
(g) of Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated; and after such closed or
executive session any final action, decision or vote with regard to any matter considered
in the closed or executive session would be made in open session, should such action,
decision or vote be necessary.
Mayor McClellan announced that the Council would go into executive session at this time to
consider the items authorized in Section 2, Paragraphs (e), (f) and (g) of Article
6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated. ATTEST:
Grace Monin
